data.exact_reserve_text: Adjustments for: Movement in technical provisions 10,799

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2014 Year of Account has closed and all assets and liabilities have been reinsured to close as at 31 December 2016. This closure resulted in a strengthening of technical provisions.

Part of an aggregate excess of loss reinsurance contract covering all casualty claim reserves (outstanding and IBNR) for Years of Account 2008 to 2014 inclusive. The cover is designed to provide capital relief for the 2016 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 10.799 million, representing 17.6% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening is primarily attributed to the finalisation of technical provisions upon the closure of the 2014 Year of Account at 31 December 2016. The closure process, which involved reinsuring all assets and liabilities, likely included an IBNR recalibration and reserve methodology adjustments. Additionally, an Adverse Development Cover (ADC) for casualty claim reserves from 2008-2014, effective from July 2015, may have influenced the final reserve position for prior years. The report does not specify individual line of business movements for prior year development.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2014 Year of Account has closed and all assets and liabilities have been reinsured to close as at 31 December 2016.
Adverse Development Cover ... covers all casualty claim reserves (both outstanding and IBNR) for Years of Account 2008 to 2014 inclusive.
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 14 shows a +6.256m strengthening for the 2014 underwriting year. However, the 'Movement in technical provisions' for the closed 2014 Year of Account on page 23 indicates a +10.799m strengthening. The latter is used as the primary prior year development figure due to the explicit closure of the 2014 Year of Account and the mention of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) arrangements, which can distort claims development triangles.
